changes.scope: Re-rendered every gallery preview from the refined templates (text fitting, motion, visual fixes, type sizes) at a higher public resolution (1280x720, was 960x540) and quality (CRF 22-24, was 26). New ranges: Doodle 1.5-24.5 s, Comedy 62.6-76.9 s, Album 9:16 26-48.6 s, DV Story 70-90 s; Album 16:9 unchanged at 3-26.733 s. Starter gains a full-length 16:9 preview; it has no 9:16 example composition.
changes.evidence: Fresh source captures and actual renders replace the earlier 960x540 records; the earlier files are preserved in the ignored local working archive.

visualReview.method: Tiled frame sheets (12 frames per preview: 0, 0.5, 1, 2 s, then eight evenly spaced) of the final 1280x720 / 720x1280 public encodes, plus dense sheets around range boundaries and transitions, low-resolution scout renders of the full Album 9:16 and Starter compositions for range choice, and all six posters. Viewed as images; this is not continuous playback or subjective listening.

rangeDecisions.doodle: 1.5-24.5 s as briefed: opens on the pink heart blooming behind "We're married!", then dancing couple, record card, doodle avatars and the moving groom/bride photo pair.
rangeDecisions.comedy: 62.6 s start as briefed (opens on the whip transition into the groom introduction card). End moved from the briefed 78.5 s to 76.9 s (frame 2306): from 76.9 s the film whips into the next "有请今天的 女主角" card, an incomplete neighbouring scene; the excerpt now fades out on the landed "新郎 林以舟" nameplate.
rangeDecisions.album-vertical: 26.0-48.6 s (frames 780-1457) of the 49.8 s 9:16 short: opens on the cut to the full-bleed chapel photo with the 誓言 title, runs through 远方, 纯白, 街角 and 夜色 layouts and fades out on the complete Happy Wedding closing card. A range to 49.8 s failed BEAT_SYNC on the 1080p source (75 ms mean) because the film's own end fade and the dissolve onto the closing card were counted as off-beat cuts; ending at 48.6 s keeps the closing card complete and passes. The catalog sample 6-22 s passes beat sync too but ends mid-gallery and spends its first seconds on the end of the title hold; the chosen range has more layout variety and a real ending.
rangeDecisions.dv-story: 70-90 s as briefed: opens mid-typing on the PLAY screen (我们一直相信...), first-chat card, Go!Go!Go! sticker, then the first photo, travel and birthday pages; ends on the complete birthday page.
rangeDecisions.starter: Full composition 0-34.9 s (frames 0-1046): the opening card, beat-cut gallery and closing card all stay watchable; the first frame is the film's own black fade-in, with the photo visible by 0.2 s and names typed by 3 s.

findings: Faces stay inside photo crops in all sampled frames; the Comedy 8.1 s extreme close-up is the template's intended punch-in.
Album 9:16: the 远方 subtitle and the 夜色 heading are now readable against their backgrounds (open item from the earlier review resolved in sampled frames).
Text at 1280x720 is sharp; captions in DV Story and Album 9:16 subtitles are small but legible at the published size.
knownRefinements: Doodle: the avatar-to-photo handover leaves near-empty paper for about 0.9 s (excerpt 18.6-19.55 s, source 20.1-21.05 s): the avatars fade to faint outlines, then the groom photo enters. Strong-content share (luma < 160 or HSV saturation > 45, at 320x180) is 0 for those frames; faint labels remain visible on direct inspection. This is in the template timing, not the excerpt choice.
Album 9:16: the dissolve onto the closing card sits about 210 ms from the nearest beat (measured on a scout render).
visualReview.limits: Only excerpts, not complete wedding films, were reviewed. No continuous playback, subjective audio, true-peak or user aesthetic acceptance is claimed.
